May 2023 — Oct 2026

DevOps Developer

Promark Electronics · Montreal, QC

Worked across the KonnectAI product team and internal IT Operations at Promark Electronics, part of Electrical Components International (ECI). Built and operated infrastructure for an AI visual-inspection platform while automating the plant’s IT and business systems.

KonnectAI & Computer Vision Team

MLOps · Infrastructure · DevOps · Cloud Operations

  • Designed reusable Terraform modules for a multi-tenant visual-inspection SaaS on Google Cloud. Managed 30 isolated customer projects across four regions, reducing onboarding from 1–2 days to a few hours.
  • Migrated YOLO training from an on-premises GPU server to a GitOps-managed GKE platform. Used Argo Workflows and Kueue to schedule jobs on Spot NVIDIA L4 GPU pools that scale to zero, cutting dataset-to-model time from six hours to two.
  • Replaced manual SSH/tmux deployments across 50–70 factory inspection stations with GitHub Actions self-hosted runners and Docker Compose. Implemented NGINX blue/green releases with WebSocket-aware sticky routing to preserve live Socket.IO inspection sessions during deployments.
  • Built GitHub Actions pipelines with keyless Workload Identity Federation, removing the need for stored, long-lived cloud credentials.
  • Added SonarQube, static analysis, and Trivy container and IaC scanning as quality gates that block builds with critical CVEs.
  • Streamed GCP billing exports and Firestore inspection data into BigQuery. Built Looker dashboards for per-client cost and usage, and model detection trends.
  • Set up Prometheus, Grafana, and Cloud Logging monitoring, routing alerts to Slack and Teams for incident response.
  • Managed secrets, identity, and access with IAM, HashiCorp Vault, and GCP KMS.

ECI / Promark IT Operations Team

IT Operations · Automation · Observability

  • Built a Python integration using the SAP Business One Service Layer, VKS API, SQL Server triggers, and Agent jobs to automate work-order handoffs between the ERP and shop floor.
  • Delivered Power BI dashboards backed by optimized SQL Server queries over SAP Business One for finance and operations reporting.
  • Automated zero-touch Linux provisioning with Ubuntu autoinstall, idempotent Ansible roles, and Bash. Reduced server builds from two days to three hours and eliminated configuration drift between test and production.
  • Administered 25–30 Linux servers running ERP systems and internal tools. Standardized patching, UFW/iptables firewalls, CIS-aligned SSH hardening, and TLS certificate renewal with Ansible and Bash, with zero certificate expiry outages.

Tools: GCP (GKE, Cloud Run, BigQuery, Firestore, Cloud SQL, Cloud Functions, KMS) · Terraform · Terragrunt · Ansible · Kubernetes · Docker · Docker Compose · Helm · ArgoCD · Argo Workflows · Kueue · GitHub Actions · NGINX · SonarQube · Trivy · HashiCorp Vault · Prometheus · Grafana · Cloud Logging · Looker · Power BI · SAP Business One · VKS API · SQL Server · Python · Bash
